title: xNFT
tagline: A Cross chain NFT renting protocol powered by connext, push and chainlink
description: This is a cross chain NFT Renting protocol using connext xcall, implementing push notifications using push protocol and onchain price feed from chainlink oracles. User can list his nft into this marketplace and provide the price at which user want to provide the nft and a renter can use xcall to call renting functions on different chains This project is not complete.
